concurrency-pools.scope: Compare real workers, a single FIFO waiting slot and a single downstream permit under the same gated arrivals.
concurrency-pools.observation: With two workers B waits for the downstream permit rather than the FIFO, C can enter, D is still rejected, and maximum downstream occupancy remains one.

gpu-execution.scope: Read the same aligned host matrix in two lane orders and verify each address and modeled 32-byte sector. Connect the address arithmetic to existing PTX compile evidence.
gpu-execution.observation: The row and column traces cover the same union of 128 sectors with different per-group sums of 128 and 1024. Native evidence is C17 on the host and CUDA compile only.

cloud-overview.scope: Continue from local readiness and liveness signals to the existing exact native Service exercise.
cloud-overview.observation: Compare the same three HTTP paths with endpoint readiness and observed backend selection, retaining the original local scope and assets.

gpu-cluster.scope: Give the exact package and recovery exercise for the existing CPU command, then separately point to a versioned own single-GPU run.
gpu-cluster.observation: The same 1024/32/2 fixture is available as continuous four epochs versus two plus two. The pinned single-card example has a different model and records 100 steps, 409600 tokens and approximately 2.57 GiB allocated.
